admission.justification: The wording test pins both sides of the 99/100 boundary so the instruction cannot silently change its threshold.

applicability: Every normal Curator authoring pass on a converted memory tree.
conditions: The worklist counts distinct outstanding memory actions once, excluding already answered, report-only and duplicate counts.
exclusions: A harness without sub-agents, which works alone and reports the limit.
Every durable write and semantic decision, which never leaves the main session.

statement: The Curator enumerates one deduplicated full-intake worklist of distinct outstanding memory actions and, at 100 or more actionable entries, fans out read/search/reference checks one level deep to sub-agents where the harness supports them; each sub-agent returns path and evidence and writes nothing durable, while invariant and family placement, admission, changes of meaning, the single knowledge-ingest write, the full memory-quality operation and the handoff stay with the main session; below 100 items fan-out is optional and an unsupported harness works alone and reports that limit.
